songs.storyConcept: A reflective song about summer memories fading like footsteps on the beach.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Footsteps washed away by the evening sea
You promised you would still remember me
Golden skies turning into indigo night
We were young, chasing every beam of light

[Chorus]
Echoes of the tide calling out your name
Even when the seasons never stay the same
Salt on my skin, warm wind in my hair
I close my eyes and you are standing there

[Verse 2]
Carved our names upon the driftwood pier
Believed our dreams would outlast any year
Now the autumn chill is creeping through the door
And the ocean waves keep crashing on the shore

[Outro]
Echoes of the tide...
Fading out in blue...
I still remember you.
songs.formattedEntrantName: Echoes of the Tide — Marina Blue (@marinablue)

songs.storyConcept: Late night cruising under neon signs thinking about second chances.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Headlights cutting through the midnight haze
Lost inside a labyrinth of yesterday's days
Radio playing static and an old slow jam
Wondering if you ever knew the boy I am

[Chorus]
Down on Starlit Boulevard
Underneath the broken sky
Every street sign reads your name
Every red light asks me why
We let the fire burn into spark
Driving all alone in the dark

[Bridge]
Gas pedal down, nothing left to lose
Just the city lights and a pair of worn-out shoes

[Chorus]
Down on Starlit Boulevard
Underneath the broken sky
I'll keep driving till sunrise
Till the memories run dry.

songs.storyConcept: A thousand folded hopes sent into the sky for someone far away.
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fold the crease along the paper spine
A silent prayer for you across the border line
Wings of white taking flight upon the breeze
Rustling softly through the cherry blossom trees

[Chorus]
One thousand paper cranes dancing in the wind
Carrying the words we never got to send
If they cross the ocean, if they reach your shore
Know that my heart is yours forevermore

[Verse 2]
Ink on parchment blurred by falling rain
A bittersweet reminder that hope outlives the pain
Every crane a memory of the days we shared
Every gentle fold proof of how much I cared

[Outro]
Paper cranes in the wind...
Fly home again.
songs.formattedEntrantName: Paper Cranes in the Wind — Sora Tanaka (@soratanaka)
